facts.rationale: Distinguishes pending acceleration from immediate velocity mutation, identifies the follow-up write, and preserves strict boundaries and input limitations.
facts.value: Forwards the fighter object first to ft_80084F3C and then to ftColl_8007AEE0. The first helper selects ground_friction, multiplying it by friction_when_above_walk_speed only when ABS(gr_vel) > walk_max_vel. Friction is clamped to -gr_vel when its magnitude exceeds the velocity magnitude, otherwise negated for positive gr_vel, then stored as xE4_ground_accel_1. Ground movement scales that pending acceleration only when the surface multiplier is below one and projects acceleration/current ground velocity along the floor normal. These helpers do not directly change gr_vel; shared fighter updating integrates and clears pending acceleration. The final helper clears shield_hit.skip_update_pos. Finite and nonnegative input invariants are not established here.
